func CheckHeads(in *xlsx.Sheet) {
	if row, err := in.Row(HeadRowIndex); err!= nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	} else {
		for idx := range NKey {
			cell := row.GetCell(idx)
			if cell.String() != Keys[idx] {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("invalid head line, expected %s at index %d, got %s", Keys[idx], idx, cell.String()))

	}
}

func WriteHeadLine(row *xlsx.Row) {
	for _, v := range Keys {
		row.AddCell().SetString(v)
	}
